selection: Among six training winners choose highest validation Sharpe (rf=0), then lower max drawdown, then lower turnover, then method name, then seed. Never use test or transfer outcomes for selection.
objective: Mean of three training-fold net Sharpes minus 0.25 times their population standard deviation.
scope: Daily long-only whole-share research prototype, one asset plus cash; no external inflows, no leverage, no real orders. ETF sample chosen in advance; no claim of unbiased universe selection.
dividends: Forward total-return signal includes ex-date dividends. Ledger records entitlement before ex-date open orders; payment cash becomes available 35 calendar days later as an explicit proxy, not actual payment dates.
test_policy: Freeze protocol and selection before inspecting 2022-2025 outcomes. No retuning after test; later methodological fixes are logged and test becomes seen data. Historical retrospective test is not prospective performance.
